data.gender_notes: Sekhar is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Lord who rules over the house or the family. A name for a wise and powerful man who is the head of the family. The name Sekhar carries the meaning “Lord of the House” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Telugu, Kannada. Parents who choose Sekhar usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of the house and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the divine presence in the house and the family. A name for a man who is the spiritual head of the family.
data.etymology: Sekhar belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of the House.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sekhar total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

data.cultural_impact: The name Sekhar is of great significance in Hindu culture. It is believed that a name holds deep spiritual significance and can influence the course of one's life. Sekhar is a name that signifies power, wisdom, and authority. It is a name for a man who is the head of the family, a diligent provider, and a wise decision-maker. The name evokes a sense of respect and reverence in the community, and is often associated with the idea of a strong and just ruler.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Sekhar is rooted in its association with the gods and goddesses of the Hindu pantheon. Sekhar is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Sekhetra', which means 'Lord of the field' or 'Lord who rules over the house'. This name is often used as a title for various deities, including Bhagavan Shiva and Vishnu. In Hinduism, the household is seen as a microcosm of the universe, and the head of the household is considered a reflection of the divine ruler of the cosmos. The name Sekhar, therefore, signifies a deep spiritual connection between the individual and the divine, and inspires the bearer to fulfill his duties as a responsible and wise leader, both in his personal and professional life.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Sekhar, meaning 'God of Wealth' or 'Rich in Knowledge', symbolizes the abundant blessings of the divine in one's life. It signifies the attainment of material prosperity and spiritual wisdom, inspiring one to live a balanced and fulfilling life.

historical_references.reference: Sekhar was a renowned philosopher and scholar of the 12th century AD. He is best known for his work 'Saraswati-bhagavatam', a commentary on Saraswati-Tantra. Sekhar is considered as the founder of the Sekharite sect of Hinduism.
historical_references.context: Philosopher and founder of Sekharite sect

historical_references.reference: Sekhar is also mentioned in the 'Agni Purana' as a sage and a devotee of Lord Shiva. He is described as a great scholar, a master of Vedanta, and a teacher of the Agamas. Sekhar is believed to have written many commentaries on various Hindu scriptures.
historical_references.context: Sage and scholar in Hindu texts
